note: Sources the continuous collector (tools/collect_daemon.py) is allowed to poll. A source may be listed here only if it has a permission capture in research/08-provenance/LEDGER.jsonl; the collector re-checks that gate on every tick and refuses otherwise. Cadence is a floor, not a promise: the scheduler fires every 5 minutes and a source is served when its own cadence has elapsed. 2026-09-09: eleven news/official feeds added by the news audit (07-legal/NEWS_AUDIT_2026-09-09.md); each one enters only if its capture of the same day measured permission - the gate below decides, not this list.

sources.name: SEPA air quality HVD API - hourly preliminary means
sources.phenomenon_time_published: yes - time_start_utc/time_end_utc per hourly mean; published_at_utc is resultTime; data_status preliminary
sources.why_window: without from= the endpoint returns the whole 30-day bundle (140 MB, measured 2026-09-08); 2 h covers the previous hour plus late publication; repeats are removed by the seen-set, not by the source
sources.why_station_ids: Belgrade bbox 44.60-44.95 / 20.20-20.65 from /api/v1/stations on 2026-09-06 (32 of 87 national stations); raw responses keep all 87

source_clock_note.text: SEPA HVD labels local time (UTC+2, CEST) as 'Z': published_at_utc 22:50:17Z was received at 20:52Z on 2026-09-08 and hourly rows ending 22:00Z arrived at 20:52Z. Rows keep the label as received; phenomenonTimeCorrected/resultTimeCorrected are our ESTIMATE (minus 2 h) and are marked so. Re-check after the clocks change on 2026-10-25.

sources.phenomenon_time_published: YES - the page prints the 'termin' (local time); converted to UTC by the project's DST rule and marked on every row

source_clock_note.text: RHMZ prints local time (CET/CEST) without an offset; phenomenonTime is our conversion and says so in phenomenonTimeSource

sources.name: NOAA Aviation Weather METAR - LYBE (Beograd/Nikola Tesla)
sources.phenomenon_time_published: YES - obsTime, a UNIX epoch published with the observation; reportTime kept separately as resultTime
sources.legal: US federal government data, public domain; no key, no Content-Signal; /robots.txt answers 404 (a 404 is no robots.txt)
sources.why: the only instrument near Belgrade that publishes its own observation instant every half hour - dew point and QNH pressure exist nowhere else in the live layer

spatial_note.text: the station is at the airport, 15 km west of the centre; every row carries the airport's coordinates and is never read as a citywide value

sources.name: RHMZ river gauges - Sava at Beograd, Dunav at Zemun
sources.phenomenon_time_published: YES - the page states its own reading time in UTC in the heading; nothing is converted
sources.legal: official materials of a body exercising public function - Copyright Act Art. 6(2), outside copyright
sources.why: the two rivers are the city's largest physical fact and the only public real-time hydrology inside it; '*' is recorded as missing, never as zero
